blurb: The Sun-like γ = 5/3 star threaded by a tangled Kolmogorov field (β_M = 10^4) passes deep inside the tidal radius of a million-solar-mass black hole (β = 1.5) and is torn apart: the streams' field is stretched along them.

featured.label: Perturber : star mass
featured.tip: Mass of the black hole over the star’s. Sets the orbit: changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Impact parameter β
featured.tip: Tidal radius over pericenter distance: above 1 the star passes inside the tidal radius. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Field strength β_M
featured.tip: Guillochon & McCourt's beta_M = 1 / Az: about the ratio of the gas pressure to the magnetic pressure B^2 / 2 through the star (a quarter of it at the dipole's center). The larger, the weaker the field. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Random seed
featured.tip: Which random field: each seed gives another. Changing it starts the run again
